Local Yo-Yo Brands

Support homegrown Malaysian yo-yo makers and discover the brands.

28Spin

28Spin was founded by two siblings, Raymond Thian and Mimi Thian. It is a Malaysia-based competition and collector yo-yo store, curated around one idea: The Throws That Win. Every model they carry has been chosen, not just stocked. Each one is a signature throw proven by the champions who compete with them, so players know they are getting yo-yos with a real track record. Whether you are a competitor looking for your next throw or a collector hunting for something special, it is a store built around quality over quantity. Visit the website to browse the full collection. In a market full of choices, that focus makes it easy to shop with confidence. Every throw on the shelf has earned its place, so you can spend less time second-guessing and more time practicing, performing and competing.

Visit Website

Alternatives

ALT (“alternatives”) is a Malaysian-founded, competition-grade yo-yo brand established by Ho Swee Jim. Known for its precision engineering, ALT is backed by a team of national and Asia-Pacific champions who put its designs to the test on the competition stage. Beyond making yo-yos, the brand also nurtures emerging talent into competitive champions, helping the next generation of Malaysian players grow. Its models include the Insomnia 7068, Inertia, Lacrima, and Key. Visit the website to explore the lineup and see what the brand is up to. Every release reflects the same commitment to detail, from the first design to the final throw. For competitors, that means dependable performance when it matters most. ALT proves that great yo-yos and great players grow best together. Quality you can feel in every spin.

Visit Website

Kedaiyoyo

Kedaiyoyo is Malaysia's largest online and physical yo-yo store, founded by 8x Malaysia yo-yo champion Ewin Ee. It is also an Official Storefront on Shopee Malaysia, making it easy to order from anywhere in the country. The range covers yo-yos for all skill levels, international heavyweights, premium & competition labels, and regional & local favorites, alongside alternative skill toys, parts & accessories, and lifestyle & miscellaneous items. Whether you are picking up your very first yo-yo or upgrading your setup, it is a one-stop shop for the community. Visit the website to start shopping. With a physical store and an online shop working side by side, the community can browse and shop in whichever way suits them. It is a place where beginners find their feet and seasoned players find their next favorite.

Visit Website

Yoyoskeel

Yoyoskeel is Malaysia's first and leading local yo-yo brand, founded in 2010 by 7x Malaysia national yo-yo champion Muhammad Shakeel Mohd Rose. The company focuses on skill toys and high-performance, competition-grade yo-yos designed by players, for players. Being created by a champion means the designs are shaped by real experience of what it takes to compete. Its models include Starting Point, Strive, Sleek, Splendid & S.Ti.M. Follow the brand on Instagram for the latest updates and releases. As a pioneer of the local scene, the brand shows that Malaysian-made yo-yos can stand proudly among the best. From the first throw to the podium, there is a model built to match your ambition, and a community of players ready to cheer you on. Every release carries a champion's standard of quality.

View on Instagram

YoyoRanger

YoyoRanger is a Malaysian yo-yo brand co-founded by Stanley Low Jia Cheng as Director/Owner and Roy Teo, who served as Head Judge of the Asia-Pacific Yo-Yo Championships from 2003 to 2025. Specializing in premium competition-grade yo-yos at affordable prices, the brand is backed by Stanley’s commitment to grassroots community building through TRYO Club in Terengganu, regional competitions and the Malaysia Yo-Yo Championship. In 2018, the Malaysian team won the Artistic Team Performance category at the World Yo-Yo Contest in Shanghai, combining high-level yo-yo play with traditional Chinese drumming. Notable models include the Libra and Rex 2.0. It is a brand that proves serious performance does not have to come with a serious price, while keeping the community at the heart of everything it does.

View on Instagram

Singwon Yoyo

Singwon Yoyo is the first professional yo-yo brand from Sabah, East Malaysia (Borneo). It was founded by Timothy Wong Sing Won, a yo-yo enthusiast and retailer, and officially launched on April 23, 2016, during the Sabah Open YoYo Championship. Its models include South Peak, Brooke, Odora & Patriot JP, a bi-metal high-performance yo-yo released in collaboration with 3x Malaysia YoYo Champion Hassan Marialis. As a homegrown brand from Borneo, it is a proud addition to the Malaysian yo-yo scene. Follow the brand on Instagram to see its latest news. Launched on the stage of a championship, the brand was born in the middle of the community it serves. It shows that great ideas can come from anywhere, including the heart of Borneo, and every new release is another step in putting East Malaysia firmly on the yo-yo map.

View on Instagram

Yo Blitz

Founded in 2007 by Ryan Han in Kuching, Sarawak, East Malaysia (Borneo), Yo Blitz is a Yo-Yo Education & Performance Brand dedicated to inspiring the next generation through interactive workshops, live performances and skill development. By bringing the art of yo-yo into schools, learning centres and community events, Yo Blitz combines entertainment with learning, helping children develop creativity, focus, coordination, patience and confidence. Beyond education and performance, Ryan Han also created Motordrill-Z Yo-Yo Strings, contributing to the yo-yo community through his own specialised string brand. Every workshop and show turns a simple toy into a lesson in perseverance, and every smile in the audience is proof that yo-yo is for everyone. It keeps the spirit of play alive while building skills that last.

View on Facebook

GCC

Hassan Marialis is a celebrated figure in the Malaysian yo-yo scene, widely regarded as one of the most creative and innovative players. 5x National Champion, his competitive career began in earnest in 2008, and he became a pioneer of the 3A style (two unresponsive yo-yos) in Malaysia, being the first to win that category at the Malaysia Yo-Yo Championship. Beyond his 16th-place finish at the World Yo-Yo Contest in Japan. Today, he continues to support the community through his specialty store, Gaming Culture & Collectibles (GCC), in Klang and remains a prominent brand ambassador for Malaysian yo-yoing. From the competition floor to the shop counter, his passion has never slowed down. For many players in Malaysia, the name is a reminder that creativity, persistence and a love for the game can take you a long way.

View on Instagram

Dement

Dement Clothing by Euphorya was founded in 2005 by Singaporean yo-yo player Fajar Siddiq, now based in Malaysia as a digital nomad. Starting in 1998 during the Hyper Yo-Yo and THP era, he won his first Malaysian yo-yo contest at Toyzbar in 2000 and represented Duncan Toys professionally from 2002–2014. A pioneer of Singapore’s off-string and freehand yo-yo scenes, he mentors, judges, performs, and designs official MYYA gear and branding. His projects include Throw Clothing, Dement Yo-Yo Cup in KL. Rooted in Yishun, his “Made in Yishun” spirit and “Fight for Passion!” slogan unite over 100 community members across Southeast Asia through yo-yoing, streetwear, fixed gear, skateboarding, freestyle scooter riders, football freestyle, running, cycling & streetwear modelling.

Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to common questions

What is the Malaysia Yo-Yo Association (MYYA)?

MYYA is dedicated to growing Malaysia’s yo-yo community through competitions, coaching, events, meetups, and community activities. We’ve been active for 20+ years, taught 1000+ students, organised 100+ events, and have 600+ members across the country.

I’m a complete beginner. How do I start yo-yoing?

Start by joining our free community. You’ll learn and create tricks with other players, meet experienced yo-yo players at meetups, and get guidance from MYYA Yo-Yo Masters. If you want a structured path, the Official Member + Grading pack includes a yo-yo with string and grading cards covering 30 tricks.

How do I join? Free vs Official membership

The community is free forever (RM 0): you get access to official MYYA meetups and hangouts, merchant discounts, and our WhatsApp and Facebook groups. The Official MYYA Member + Grading is a one-time RM 100 for lifetime membership, and includes a black MYYA T-shirt, a yo-yo and string, 3 grading cards (30 tricks), a certificate of participation, and a signed and graded yo-yo from a Yo-Yo Master.

Where can I find official updates, meetups, and announcements?

Follow our official Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube pages, or join the Malaysia Yo-Yo WhatsApp and Facebook groups. This website is an independent project by MYYA to connect yo-yo players, so for event details and announcements, always refer to our official channels.

The Malaysia Yo-Yo Association is dedicated to growing Malaysia’s yo-yo community through competitions, coaching, events, meetups, and community activities. This website is an independent project by the Malaysia Yo-Yo Association, created to support and connect yo-yo players across the country.
